hazards.label: Wall socket
hazards.fix: Fit socket covers or use shuttered sockets on every socket a baby can reach, and switch sockets off when not in use.

hazards.query: a wall switch board with sockets
hazards.label: Switch board
hazards.fix: If the board is low enough to reach, cover the sockets and keep chargers and plugs out of it when not in use.

hazards.label: Extension board
hazards.fix: Lift extension boards off the floor or put them in a closed cable box; switch off and unplug when not in use.

hazards.label: Loose cable
hazards.fix: Tuck cables behind furniture or into cord covers so they cannot be chewed or pulled.

hazards.query: a phone charger plugged into a socket
hazards.label: Charger left plugged in
hazards.fix: Unplug chargers when not in use; a baby can put the pin of a live charger in the mouth.

hazards.label: Stairs
hazards.fix: Fit a screw-mounted safety gate at the top and a gate at the bottom of the stairs.

hazards.label: Window
hazards.fix: Fit window guards or stops so it opens no more than about 10 cm, and keep beds and furniture away from windows.

hazards.label: Balcony
hazards.fix: Keep the balcony door locked; check that railing gaps are too narrow for a baby and move anything climbable away.

hazards.label: Tall shelf
hazards.fix: Anchor tall shelves to the wall with anti-tip straps or brackets; keep heavy things on the bottom shelves.

hazards.label: TV
hazards.fix: Mount the TV on the wall or anchor it to a low, stable stand; hide the cables.

hazards.label: Chest of drawers
hazards.fix: Anchor it to the wall; a baby climbing the open drawers can pull it over.

hazards.label: Floor lamp
hazards.fix: Move floor lamps behind furniture or replace them while the baby is learning to stand.

hazards.label: Sharp corner
hazards.fix: Fit soft corner guards on sharp corners at the baby's head height.

hazards.label: Knife
hazards.fix: Store knives and scissors in a latched or high drawer.

hazards.label: Scissors
hazards.fix: Store scissors and blades in a latched or high drawer.

hazards.label: Medicines
hazards.fix: Lock medicines away, up high, in their child-resistant packs; never leave them on tables or in bags.

hazards.label: Cleaning products
hazards.fix: Store cleaners, detergents and pesticides locked or high, in their original bottles; fit cabinet latches.

hazards.label: Coins
hazards.fix: Keep coins and anything smaller than a toilet-roll tube out of reach; they are choking hazards.

hazards.label: Batteries
hazards.fix: Keep button batteries, remotes and spare batteries out of reach; a swallowed button battery burns within hours.

hazards.label: Plastic bag
hazards.fix: Keep plastic bags and wrappers out of reach; knot them and throw them away.

hazards.label: Small objects
hazards.fix: Clear small objects off the floor and low tables; test them with a toilet-roll tube.

hazards.label: Stove
hazards.fix: Turn pot handles inward, cook on the back burners, fit knob covers and keep the baby out of the kitchen while cooking.

hazards.label: Gas cylinder
hazards.fix: Turn the regulator off after cooking and block the baby's access to the cylinder and pipe.

hazards.label: Iron
hazards.fix: Unplug the iron and put it away out of reach as soon as you finish; keep the cord out of reach while it cools.

hazards.label: Kettle
hazards.fix: Keep kettles and their cords at the back of the counter; never hold hot drinks while holding the baby.

hazards.label: Room heater
hazards.fix: Guard the heater, keep it out of the baby's room or switched off, and keep cords out of reach.

hazards.label: Flame
hazards.fix: Keep candles, diyas and lighters out of reach and never leave a flame alone.

hazards.label: Bucket
hazards.fix: Never leave water standing in buckets or tubs; empty them and store them upside down. A baby can drown in a few centimetres of water.

hazards.label: Toilet
hazards.fix: Keep the toilet lid down and the bathroom door closed; fit a lid lock.

hazards.label: Bathtub
hazards.fix: Empty the tub right after use and never leave the baby alone in or near water.

hazards.label: Hanging cord
hazards.fix: Tie up or cut blind and curtain cords, and keep the cot away from windows.

hazards.label: House plant
hazards.fix: Check the plant is not poisonous and keep pots and soil out of reach.
